Based on the provided search results, I can provide the officially documented context window and output token limits for the **Claude** model family. However, the search results do not contain information regarding the **GPT** (OpenAI) model family.

### Claude Model Family Limits

The current Claude models are divided into two primary tiers regarding context window capacity: those with a 1 million token context window and those with a 200,000 token context window.

**1. Models with 1 Million Token Context Window**
Models including Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and Claude Sonnet 5 support a 1 million token context window.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Mythos Preview have a 1M-token context window." | CLAIM: These specific Claude models have a context window of 1 million tokens.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "A single request to any of them can generate up to 128k output tokens (`max_tokens`)." | CLAIM: The standard maximum output limit for these 1M-context models is 128,000 tokens.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/overview | QUOTE: "On the Message Batches API, Claude Opus 5.5 supports up to 300k output tokens with the `output-300k-2026-03-24` beta header." | CLAIM: Certain models, including Opus 5.5, can generate up to 300,000 output tokens when using the Message Batches API with a specific beta header.

**2. Models with 200,000 Token Context Window**
Other models, such as Claude Haiku 4.5 and Claude Sonnet 4.5, operate with a smaller context window.

SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models | QUOTE: "Other Claude models, including Claude Sonnet 4.5, have a 200k-token context window." | CLAIM: Models like Claude Sonnet 4.5 have a 200,000 token context window.

SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models | QUOTE: "Context window... 200k tokens is roughly 150k words." | CLAIM: The 200k token context window is approximately equivalent to 150,000 words.

SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models | QUOTE: "Max output... Claude Haiku 4.5... 64K tokens" | CLAIM: Claude Haiku 4.5 has a maximum output limit of 64,000 tokens.

**3. General Context Window Behavior**
The context window includes all input data, and exceeding it results in specific errors or stop reasons depending on the model version.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "Everything in the request counts toward the context window: the system prompt, every message in `messages` (including tool results, images, and documents), and your tool definitions." | CLAIM: All components of the API request contribute to the context window usage.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "If the input alone already exceeds the model's context window, the API returns a 400 `invalid_request_error` ("prompt is too long") on every model." | CLAIM: Requests where the input exceeds the context window limit are rejected with a 400 error.
